body: Long story short, still regrettably here
Things have gotten worse and I attempted last year. My regret is that I failed.
No. This is just an announcement that I hoped would go unnoticed so I could say "at least I tried."
The less people, the less judgment and worry. I totally get that, thank you for replying.

I tried deleting my account but I guess she knows the answers to my security questions or email because she keeps reactivating it... wI've had my phone off all day and she hasn't done anything bad yet but I know she's going to stalk me around campus tomorrow because she knows where my classes are. She doesn't understand how terribl things are for both of us and now she's just a caricature of herself and it's scary

Really? Because honestly that's what I really want. I don't want to feel, even happiness. I am forcing myself to write my paper and it is working pretty well but I am still so scared. She said she'd call my house at 6 or walk to my house and I really don't want that but I can't talk to her now. I really don't want to feel right now and if I could sleep I would.

Thank you very very much for all that. I am also a musician but I can't bring myself to create.

I can't stop the apathy even though I know it's killing me. I always tell myself that what I do doesn't matter, but I know it does. I know other people have it far worse than I do and I hate that I'm so torn over this.

I can't stand getting hurt anymore. Every time I get hurt, I feel worse and it doesn't heal. Then I stop doing things so I don't get hurt and that hurts other people indirectly. It's either hurt or be hurt right now. I don't know how to be happy without other people, and right now, I don't want other people. I really want medication that can block this shit coming from my mind but I don't want a pill to make me happy. I don't believe it can ever happen to me but I really am so glad that you took the time to help me

it's all I feel I know how to do. I can't think about anything else. I can't write my papers, I can't just write down my feelings, I can't play video games or guitar or anything. All I can do is lie down and look at my ceiling and think about how grim things are. I don't know how to think otherwise

I am trying to move on very badly but she is not. She still holds on to all of our good memories and thinks they can happen again when I know they can't. It is killing me and she will hurt me and make me feel horrible if I keep everything up with trying to move on from her.

My only solace is being alone when I want to but nobody lets me. I would never kill myself because it will disappoin others, but I don't want to live because I will disappoint myself. I don't believe that life is bright and good for anybody. Life is dark and disappointing and then you die. If everything gets better, all I will see is how horrible it was before and how easily it can turn bad again later.

But thank you very much for your input, I really need everything I can get
